briefing: - 本批未标记KEV或在野利用，亦无勒索软件关联，但高危RCE仍需按潜在利用处置。
- Chrome多枚9.6高危含UAF/授权错误，需优先升级。
- Sureline 9.8及CI代码注入RCE批量披露，边界与CI紧急排查。

items.title: Chrome Android越权致跨源数据泄露
items.title_zh: Chrome Android越权致跨源数据泄露
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者诱使Android Chrome打开恶意HTML，可越权读取跨源数据。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: google chrome <156.0.8078.47
items.action_zh: 升级至156.0.8078.47及以上，提醒用户勿点可疑链接
items.repro_note: 诱使Android Chrome访问恶意HTML触发跨源读取
items.impact_scope: Android Chrome用户，需用户交互
items.description: Missing authorization in Core in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 156.0.8078.47 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to obtain cross-origin data via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

items.title: SureLine会话Cookie伪造认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可伪造仅含用户名的Cookie，仿冒有活动会话的用户。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.affected: sunhillo sureline >=8.0.0 <9.1.5
items.action_zh: 升级至9.1.5及以上，临时限制Web管理面访问
items.repro_note: 伪造仅含用户名的会话Cookie，需目标存在活动会话
items.impact_scope: SureLine Web管理面，可仿冒用户
items.description: Sunhillo SureLine before 9.1.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to impersonate any user with an active web session by forging a session cookie containing only a cleartext username with no random identifier or integrity protection.

items.title: Puppet Server报告反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 持有任意CA签发agent证书者可提交恶意报告，在Puppet Server执行代码。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，限制agent证书签发与报告提交
items.repro_note: 持CA签发agent证书，向报告处理PUT提交恶意rich-data
items.impact_scope: Puppet Server，内网配置管理核心
items.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in the report-processing code of Puppet, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected releases, allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as its service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type via PUT request. Where the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain such a certificate.

items.title: SonicWall GMS未授权文件读取
items.summary_zh: 网络可达的未认证攻击者可读取GMS内部文件，泄露敏感信息。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至9.5.2以上修复版本，限制GMS网络访问
items.repro_note: 未授权访问GMS服务读取内部文件，需网络可达
items.impact_scope: GMS管理设备，常暴露内网
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 and earlier versions may be able to read internal GMS files, potentially exposing sensitive information.

items.title: OpenAPI 未授权 代码注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.description: A multi-response OpenAPI operation with an attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced second non-primary response key can close the dictionary-key literal and inject a valid Python expression. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the application's or CI process's privileges when the generated module is imported and its decorator arguments are evaluated.

items.title: Python 未授权 代码注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.description: An attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced operation summary can close the docstring and inject a valid Python expression statement into the handler body. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the server process's privileges when the affected route handler is called.

items.title: OpenAPI 未授权 代码注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.description: An attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced OpenAPI path can close the string and inject a valid Python expression into the decorator argument. Syntax-breaking input only causes generation to fail, but syntactically valid generated code executes with the application's or CI process's privileges when the generated module is imported and the decorator is evaluated.

items.title: OPC UA 未授权 CWE-285
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.description: node-opcua is an OPC UA implementation for TypeScript and Node.js. Servers with no declared policy, nodes with explicit per-node permissions, and correctly bound programmatic namespace metadata are outside the authorization-bypass case.

items.title: Puppet证书名校验错误授权绕过
items.title_zh: Puppet证书名校验错误授权绕过
items.summary_zh: 持有CA签发碰撞名称证书者可绕过主机授权，冒充授权主机。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，收紧CA签发与autosign策略
items.repro_note: 需CA签发名称扩展或缩短的主机证书绕过授权匹配
items.impact_scope: Puppet Server授权，需受信证书
items.description: Incorrect authorization in the certificate-name matching of trapperkeeper-authorization, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected products, allows a client that holds a CA-signed certificate whose name extends or shortens an authorized hostname to be authorized as that host. Exploitation requires a certificate with a colliding name, which the certificate authority issues by approval or autosign.

items.title: 360路由器host参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 可访问管理面的攻击者操纵host参数注入系统命令，可能远程执行代码。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取修复固件，限制管理面访问
items.repro_note: 向host参数注入系统命令，需可访问管理面
items.impact_scope: 360多款路由器，家庭/小型网络
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Qihoo 360 D603-2, D600-2, D606-6 and D706 up to 6.4.9. This affects the function testspeed_command of the file /fs2/bin/iscm. Performing a manipulation of the argument host results in os command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 360 M5路由器硬编码凭据
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可使用固件内置凭据登录管理界面，获取管理员权限。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级固件，修改默认口令并限制管理面访问
items.repro_note: 使用固件内置凭据登录管理界面
items.impact_scope: 360家庭路由器M5管理权限
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Qihoo 360 Whole Home Router M5 4.0.17.1566. This issue affects the function Home of the file /etc/init.d/mpt of the component Boot Script. The manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG无线配置栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向cstecgi.cgi的wepkey参数发送超长数据，触发栈溢出。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级固件修复；无法升级则限制cgi接口访问
items.repro_note: 向/cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi的wepkey参数发送超长数据
items.impact_scope: TOTOLINK A950RG路由器
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This impacts the function strcpy of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Basic Wireless Configuration Handler. The manipulation of the argument wepkey leads to stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG多SSID溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向多SSID配置的wepkey2/3参数传超长值，触发栈溢出。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级固件修复；无法升级则限制cgi接口访问
items.repro_note: 向cstecgi.cgi多SSID配置wepkey2/3传超长值
items.impact_scope: TOTOLINK A950RG路由器
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected is the function setWiFiMultipleConfig/delWiFiMultipleConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component Multi-SSID Configuration. The manipulation of the argument wepkey2/wepkey3 results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG MAC栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向MAC过滤addEffect参数发送超长数据，触发栈溢出。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级固件修复；无法升级则限制cgi接口访问
items.repro_note: 向cstecgi.cgi的addEffect参数发送超长数据
items.impact_scope: TOTOLINK A950RG路由器
items.description: A flaw has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this vulnerability is the function setMacFilterRules of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component MAC Filter Handler. This manipulation of the argument addEffect causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: gohttpserver ZipSlip写入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向/upload上传恶意Zip，利用路径穿越写入任意文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至1.3.0以上修复版本，禁用或限制上传
items.repro_note: 向/upload上传含../路径的Zip写入任意文件
items.impact_scope: gohttpserver文件服务，上传功能
items.description: A Zip Slip vulnerability in the /upload endpoint of codeskyblue gohttpserver through v1.3.0 allows attackers to write arbitrary files via uploading a crafted Zip archive.

items.title: HPE Fabric Composer硬编码
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可使用CLI硬编码凭据登录，获取高权限管理访问。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用CLI硬编码账户并限制访问
items.repro_note: 使用CLI内置硬编码口令远程登录管理
items.impact_scope: HPE网络编排系统管理面
items.description: Hardcoded password vulnerabilities in the command-line interface of HPE Networking Fabric Composer could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to access the affected system using hardcoded credentials. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized administrative access to the affected system with elevated privileges.

items.title: Etrel充电桩默认凭据管理员登录
items.title_zh: Etrel充电桩默认凭据管理员登录
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者使用出厂默认账号登录Web管理界面，获取完全管理员权限。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至7.1.2/8.0.1以上，修改默认口令
items.repro_note: 以出厂默认账号登录充电桩Web管理界面
items.impact_scope: Etrel充电桩Web管理，可获管理员
items.description: Etrel INCH AC charging station management web interface prior to firmware versions 7.1.2 and 8.0.1 contains a hard-coded default credentials vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain full Administrator access by authenticating with the factory-default account. Attackers can log in over cleartext HTTP to obtain complete charger configuration, OCPP ChargePoint Identity, and CSMS WebSocket connection details, enabling unauthorized administrative control of the charging station.

items.title: Emerson Ovation协议缺失认证

items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，隔离OT网络并限制协议端口访问
items.repro_note: 向Ovation协议端口发送未认证配置或控制报文
items.impact_scope: Ovation控制器，OT内网
items.description: Emerson Ovation has several protocols that have no authentication, which could allow an attacker to change controller configuration or cause a denial-of-service condition.

items.repro_note: 向NoMachine服务发送恶意构造数据触发堆溢出
items.impact_scope: NoMachine远程桌面服务，可RCE
items.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NoMachine. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.

items.title: HPE网络编排系统认证绕过RCE
items.title_zh: HPE网络编排系统认证绕过RCE
items.summary_zh: 相邻网络未认证攻击者可绕过底层系统认证并执行任意代码。
items.difficulty: 低(需相邻网络·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，隔离相邻网络并限制管理访问

items.title: Chrome DevTools授权错误RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者构造HTML页面并诱导用户访问，可越出沙箱执行任意代码。

items.affected: Google Chrome(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)

items.title: Windows CWE-424
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: In Docker Desktop for Windows with the WSL2 backend, an unprivileged Linux container can use 32-bit socketcall to bypass the default seccomp restriction on AF_VSOCK. This can expose host-facing services and Windows files accessible to the logged-in user. The issue affects x86-64 WSL2; LinuxKit-based backends are unaffected. The issue is fully fixed only with Docker Desktop 4.98.0 or later and WSL 3.0.3 or later. Docker Desktop 4.98.0 or later running on an older WSL remains affected.

items.title: 注入
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需高权限)
items.description: A flaw has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0 Build 202004151405. This issue affects the function loadstring of the file usr/lib/lua/luci/controller/api/zrUsb.lua of the component Lua Handler. This manipulation causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Dell Wyse Management Suite XSS
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: Dell Wyse Management Suite, versions prior to 2609.0.0.155, contain an Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability.
